summary.zh: 按公司代码、年度和期间执行 FI/CO/MM/SD 月结检查，汇总异常、数据缺口、阻塞项和可追踪待办。
summary.en: Runs FI/CO/MM/SD closing checks by company, year and period, then reports findings, data gaps, blockers and traceable tasks.

zh: 月结 checklist 与只读证据
可关账/不建议关账/存在阻塞项
所有 SAP 操作只读
缺数不会解释成零异常
不会执行 OB52、MMPV、AFAB、F.05、F.13、MR11 或任何关账动作
最终动作必须人工确认
en: Missing data is never treated as zero exceptions
Never executes OB52, MMPV, AFAB, F.05, F.13, MR11 or closing actions

description.zh: 要求公司代码、年度、期间和 SAP client 完整一致，并读取版本化 checklist。
description.en: Requires a consistent company, year, period and SAP client, then loads the versioned checklist.

purpose.zh: 定义 12 项检查、阈值和阻塞规则
purpose.en: Defines 12 checks, thresholds and blocker rules

title.zh: 优先收集 Runtime 证据

description.zh: 检查健康状态、目录、schema、计划和完整分页，只接收范围绑定且验证通过的只读结果。
description.en: Checks health, catalog, schema, plans and pagination, accepting only validated scope-bound read-only results.

purpose.zh: 执行批准的本地只读查询
白名单、字段、分页和生产批准门
purpose.en: Allowlist, fields, pagination and production approval gate

description.zh: 仅在 MCP 缺数时接收经 scope、SAP client、行数和 SHA-256 复核的 GUI/SE16N 证据。
description.en: Accepts GUI/SE16N evidence only for MCP gaps after scope, client, row-count and SHA-256 review.

purpose.zh: 验证 MCP bundle 与 case ID
purpose.en: Validates MCP bundles and case IDs

purpose.zh: 验证 manifest、允许表和文件哈希
purpose.en: Validates manifests, allowed tables and file hashes

purpose.zh: 由人员触发的受控只读补证

description.zh: 执行 AP、AR、GL、AA、CO、MM 与 SD 的 12 项检查，区分通过、异常和 DATA_GAP。
description.en: Runs 12 AP, AR, GL, AA, CO, MM and SD checks and separates pass, finding and DATA_GAP.

purpose.zh: 模块检查器和统一阈值求值
purpose.en: Module checkers and unified threshold evaluation

description.zh: 根据阻塞与严重度规则输出三态结论，期间结束前仅标记预关账快照。
description.en: Produces the three-state conclusion from blockers and severity; pre-period-end results remain snapshots.

purpose.zh: 异常聚合、fail-closed 和三态结论
purpose.en: Finding aggregation, fail-closed behavior and three-state decision

description.zh: 生成结构化报告、人工可读报告和稳定 todo ID，并声明未执行任何关账动作。
description.en: Creates structured and human-readable reports with stable task IDs and an explicit no-action declaration.

purpose.en: JSON, Markdown, evidence references and owned tasks
